title: Self Assessment: Partnership Tax Return (SA800)
text:
You can send this tax return online instead of downloading the form. Find out how to send your Self Assessment tax return online .

 Use form SA800 if the only income for the return period was:

 • trading and professional income

 • taxed interest and alternative finance receipts from banks and building societies

 Include any relevant supplementary pages with your SA800 Partnership Tax Return.

 Supplementary pages

 Self Assessment: Partnership Statement (full) (SA800(PS)) 

 Self Assessment: Partnership Trading and Professional Income (SA800)(TP) 

 Self Assessment: Partnership UK property (SA801) 

 Self Assessment: Partnership Foreign (SA802) 

 Self Assessment: Partnership disposal of chargeable assets (SA803) 

 Self Assessment: Partnership savings and investments and other income (SA804) 

 Related forms and guidance

 Help with partnerships on your Self Assessment tax return
